messages:
Nina_Partners: Heads-up: final partner readiness sync for Marketplace go-live. Need to lock three things today: (1) joint blog embargo, (2) HW partner cert slot assignments, (3) SI integration dry-run schedule.
Omar_Mktg: Blog status: draft live in drive. Want embargo at Wed 09:00 PT. Need product blurb + two sentence quote by Tue 16:00 PT. Design asking for hero image by Tue noon.
Priya_Eng: Product blurb incoming. One note: we should avoid specific latency numbers in public copy until dedicated perf validation completes.
Quinn_Legal: Embargo ok for Wed 09:00 PT. Two legal points: partner logo consent required, and no named customer endorsements without signed release. I'll circulate the logo consent template.
Ray_SI: Dry-run: propose Tue 14:00 PT for a 45m session. Need staging accounts for partner SIs and scoped tokens with deploy/read scopes. Also request a 1-pager troubleshooting checklist.
Priya_Eng: Token snippet (use partner-staging): POST /tokens {role: "partner", scopes: ["catalog:read","deploy:exec"], ttl: 86400} — will paste a curl in #devex.
Nina_Partners: Thanks. @Ray_SI Ill add the SI attendees and send calendar invites. @Omar_Mktg note about latency language noted.
Omar_Mktg: Can legal sign the quote attribution by Tue 15:00 so we can hit design?
Quinn_Legal: Yes, if quotes avoid feature promises. I'll approve short attribution lines by Tue 14:30.
DeployBot: Deploy scheduled: marketplace-catalog v3.1 -> staging at 2024-07-06T02:45Z. Monitor #release-war-room.
Nina_Partners: Action items: 1) @Priya_Eng finalize product blurb (today EOD). 2) @Quinn_Legal upload logo consent + review quotes (Tue AM). 3) @Ray_SI confirm dry-run attendees & checklist (Mon). 4) @Omar_Mktg finalize hero with design (Tue noon). Any blockers? :eyes:
